basic_info.description: Chic corner condo with shared panoramic city view roof deck in prime location. Discover the epitome of San Francisco living in this beautifully updated 1-bed, 1-bath condo, situated in a boutique 3-unit building in the highly desirable Eureka Valley/Dolores Heights neighborhood, steps from the iconic Castro St retail corridor. This 1st floor corner unit seamlessly combines modern luxury with timeless charm. The recently remodeled kitchen boasts new countertops & cabinets, a Wolf gas stove, a spacious island, & a walk-in pantry. Modern upgrades include a Ring doorbell, Nest thermostat, & Hansgrohe plumbing hardware. The open living area invites relaxation with a cozy fireplace, hardwood floors, & double-paned windows that fill the space with natural light. Enjoy the spa-like bathroom with heated floors, double sinks, & chic finishes, while new light fixtures, hardware, & doors add a fresh, modern touch throughout. Practicality meets convenience with in-unit laundry, a private garage, & ample storage. The shared rooftop deck offers jaw-dropping 360-degree views of the SF skyline, Bay, East Bay hills, & Mount Diablo, perfect for entertaining or unwinding. With luxurious features, a prime location, & stunning vistas, this home offers an unparalleled slice of San Francisco living.
